name: RetroGrid
description: A perspective floor grid that scrolls slowly toward the viewer, drawn with CSS only.

angle.description: Tilt of the floor in degrees.

cellSize.description: Size of one grid cell in pixels.

color.description: Colour of the grid lines: any CSS colour or token.

duration.description: Seconds one cell takes to scroll.

isStill.description: Stops all movement. Moving content should be stoppable.

requirements: Pure decoration: aria-hidden, never focusable, and pointer-events none so content on top stays usable
Drawn with CSS only, so it needs no JavaScript and is safe in server HTML
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), with isStill, and inside an rdm-still container
Nothing flashes more than 3 times a second (WCAG 2.3.1) and moving content can be stopped (WCAG 2.2.2)
Hidden in forced-colors (high contrast) mode so it never fights system colours
Keep text on top at 4.5:1 against the effect: use a low-contrast colour

use_when: The bottom of a hero section
avoid_when: As the only sign of a boundary
anti_patterns: A fast duration: keep the scroll slow
